reasoning: This gazette notification announces the enactment of "Drinking Water and Water Catchment Safety By-Laws" for Dambulla Pradeshiya Sabha. It establishes regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and legal obligations regarding water safety and conservation. The content focuses on creating new regulatory provisions (by-laws) under existing legislation (Pradeshiya Sabha Act), which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
